name: Phishaman
tagline: Protecting Nigerians from phishing, one URL at a time
description: Phishaman is a machine learning-powered phishing detection web application built specifically for Nigerian internet users. It detects phishing attempts targeting Nigerian banks, fintechs, government portals, e-commerce platforms, news sites, and social media.
tech: Flask 3.0.3 ML: scikit-learn 1.6.1 (RandomForest) Database: SQLite Frontend: HTML5
Vanilla JavaScript Auth: JWT + bcrypt Reports: ReportLab (PDF)
